existing_trace_sources.description: Existing visual trace console v1. Fetches latest snapshot via /brain/agent-trace/latest and connects SSE to /brain/agent-trace/stream. Renders events with icon, title, text, timestamp. Supports filters: all, thinking, tool, evidence, governance.
existing_trace_sources.event_types_supported: thinking, tool, finding, file, evidence, governance, decision, status, health, warning, error
existing_trace_sources.risk: Low — no chain-of-thought displayed, no secrets in current static HTML. But backend event schema is not documented/audited.

existing_trace_sources.description: Proposal lifecycle: pending_review -> approved_for_sandbox -> sandbox_running -> evaluation_pending -> candidate_promote. Exposes score_proposal(), rank_proposals(), load_registry(). Uses PROPOSAL_REGISTRY_PATH.
existing_trace_sources.event_types_produced: proposal_created, proposal_approved_for_sandbox, sandbox_running, evaluation_pending, candidate_promote, rejected, rolled_back
existing_trace_sources.risk: Medium — proposal attribution includes evidence_refs and sources, which could contain sensitive paths if not redacted.

existing_trace_sources.description: Canonical governance health builder. Aggregates control_layer, meta_governance, risk_contract, change_validation, post_trade, edge_validation, session_memory. Writes to governance_health_latest.json.
existing_trace_sources.risk: Low-Medium — internal status fields could expose internal module errors or memory state if not filtered at UI layer.

existing_trace_sources.description: Dashboard principal. Panels: runtime, health, recent runs, proposals, approvals, evidence, logs. JavaScript panels: dashboard_primary_panels.js, dashboard_secondary_panels.js, dashboard_runtime.js.
existing_trace_sources.event_types_displayed: runtime metrics, health status, proposal list, evidence list
existing_trace_sources.risk: Medium — displays runtime metrics and proposal lists; needs redaction layer before adding chain-of-thought.

existing_trace_sources.description: Write test for TOOL-01. Logs to tmp_agent/brain_v9/ops/restart_brain_v9_result_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json.
existing_trace_sources.risk: Low — ephemeral test artifacts, no long-term retention.

gaps: No documented event schema contract between backend and frontend.
No explicit redaction layer before sending events to browser.
No governance approval/apply/reject UI visible in current dashboard panels.
No evidence citation panel linking proposals to evidence_refs.
No event persistence beyond in-memory SSE stream.
No separation between operational trace and raw chain-of-thought in current endpoint.

risks.title: Unaudited event source schema
risks.detail: The /brain/agent-trace/stream endpoint could be emitting raw events with sensitive data if backend event creation is not audited.

risks.title: No redaction layer on display
risks.detail: Current HTML receives events via direct JSON from endpoint. If any field contains secrets or raw reasoning, UI has no filters to strip them.

risks.title: No proposal approval UI in dashboard
risks.detail: proposal_governance.py manages transitions but current UI panels do not expose approve/reject controls to operator.

risks.title: No event store or replay
risks.detail: Events are transient (SSE). Debugging or auditing past runs requires manual log inspection.

risks.title: Proposal scoring may reflect private evidence
risks.detail: evidence_refs in proposals link to internal reports. UI display must redact or summarize, not show raw report content.
